concerns.text: The plan states it will download a *verified* Group Sunspot Number (GSN) dataset, but the research document explicitly notes that no verified open GSN parquet exists and the pipeline will treat GSN as unavailable. This contradicts Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) and creates a factual inconsistency between plan and research.

The Constitution Check table marks Principle II (Verified Accuracy) as ✅, yet the GSN source is unverified per research.md. This misrepresents compliance and violates the constitution’s requirement for accurate principle reporting.
